name: Precision Importance Sampling
aliases: Exact Inverse Transform Sampling under Piecewise Linear Opacity
definition: A sampling technique that derives an exact closed-form solution for inverse transform sampling by assuming piecewise linear opacity, solving the problem of the CDF being non-invertible and discontinuous under piecewise constant opacity assumptions.
summary: Precision Importance Sampling generates exact continuous samples in volume rendering by inverting the cumulative distribution function under piecewise linear opacity, avoiding the discretization errors of constant opacity models.
